verses.61:4: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُحِبُّ ٱلَّذِينَ يُقَٰتِلُونَ فِي سَبِيلِهِۦ صَفࣰّ ا كَأَنَّهُم بُنۡيَٰنࣱ مَّرۡصُوصࣱ‏

meaning: The root رصص (rSS) primarily means to make something compact, firm, or closely joined together. It implies a solid, well-arranged structure, like bricks or stones fitted tightly, leaving no gaps.
en_note: Manually curated for a Quranic hapax root.
